questions.q: What does having the **Right Attitude to Work** mean in a civic context?
options: Arriving at the workplace only when a supervisor is present
Approaching one's duties with a positive mindset, dedication, and strict adherence to professional ethics
Demanding higher pay before completing basic assigned tasks
Refusing to assist coworkers to focus entirely on personal promotion
questions.explain: The **Right Attitude to Work** refers to a positive, dedicated, and highly committed mindset toward one's job, ensuring duties are performed efficiently and ethically.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Civic Education
questions.subject: National Value Education
questions.topic: National Values: Right Attitude to Work

questions.q: An employee who consistently arrives at the office before the official resumption time and attends work every day is heavily demonstrating which two attributes?
options: Greed and Ostentation
Discipline and Transparency
Punctuality and Regularity
Tolerance and Compromise
questions.explain: **Punctuality** is arriving on time, while **Regularity** is attending consistently without unwarranted absences. Both are critical attributes of the right attitude to work.

questions.subject: National Value Education
questions.topic: National Values: Right Attitude to Work

questions.q: Why is giving rewards (such as promotions or bonuses) highly important in a working environment?
options: It strongly encourages indiscipline and laziness among unrewarded staff
It completely replaces the need for a monthly salary
It leads directly to higher productivity, efficiency, and progress
It causes unnecessary value disorientation in the society
questions.explain: Rewards provide **recognition** and motivation, which naturally stimulate workers to increase their **efficiency** and **productivity**, thereby driving organizational **progress**.

questions.q: A severe lack of the right attitude to work among critical transport operators (like pilots, sailors, and drivers) can tragically lead to which of the following?
options: Improved National Image
National disasters such as air crashes, shipwrecks, and fatal road accidents
An immediate increase in foreign investments
A highly robust and transparent electoral process
questions.explain: In sensitive professions, negligence, indiscipline, or a poor attitude to work can compromise safety procedures, resulting in tragic **national disasters** on roads, in the air, or at sea.

questions.topic: National Values: Right Attitude to Work

questions.q: Which of the following is **not** an attribute of the right attitude to work?
options: Diligence
Transparency
Commitment
Truancy
questions.explain: **Truancy** is the act of staying away from work or school without a good reason. It is the opposite of regularity and is a highly negative attitude. Attributes of a good work attitude include diligence, transparency, and commitment.

questions.topic: National Values: Right Attitude to Work

questions.q: Transparency is frequently listed as an attribute of the **Right Attitude to Work**. In a professional and civic setting, what does transparency entail?
options: Keeping all official activities and financial records completely hidden from the public
Operating with absolute openness, accountability, and truthfulness in one's official duties
Arriving exactly on time but refusing to carry out assigned tasks
Reporting coworkers to the police for minor personal disagreements
questions.explain: **Transparency** in the workplace means conducting business and official duties in an open, honest, and highly accountable manner, without hiding illicit actions or mismanaging funds.
